title: Blue Bandit Fishing Charters
specs: Fish species include Fluke, Flounder, Black Sea Bass, Cod, Haddock, Pollock, Striped Bass, Bluefish, Shark and Blue Fin Tuna
Boat is a 29 foot Seavee with twin 300 horsepower mercury engines, US Coast Guard inspected annually
You will glide through narrow channels and into isolated lagoons where hundreds, seals swim and lay out along the shore.
Although rare, there is a chance of seeing a great white shark swim by too!
Family friendly, caters to anglers of all skill levels and abilities

services.name: Seal and Harbor Cruise
services.desc: The seals of Monomoy are a rare treat to be seen close up. You will glide through narrow channels and into isolated lagoons where hundreds, seals swim and lay out along the shore. You will also see different types of seabirds! Although rare, there is a chance of seeing a great white shark swim by too! One of the best ocean fun trips for your entire family. Departure locations April to June: Sesuit Harbor (Dennis) Mid-June to November: Saquatucket Harbor (Harwich) What to bring Appropriate clothing for weather conditions Camera Sunglasses Sunscreen Hat Food/ Beverages Closed toed shoes All ages • 2-4 Hours • Up to 6 people

blurb: Blue Bandit Charters offers fishing trips on Cape Cod with options including half day, full day deep sea fishing, inshore fishing charters, and coastal cruises. They fish for species such as Fluke, Flounder, Black Sea Bass, Cod, Haddock, Pollock, Striped Bass, Bluefish, Shark, and Blue Fin Tuna. The boat is a 29 foot Seavee with twin 300 horsepower engines, US Coast Guard inspected annually.
